title: Alanine Transaminase Assay Protocol
author: Peter Havel
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ybtfsnn

steps.title: Add Samples to Microplate
steps.instruction: Add 10 μl of each sample or standard in duplicate to the microplate wells, ensuring no bubbles are introduced during dispensing.

steps.title: Incubate with ALT Reagent
steps.instruction: Add 50 μl of ALT Reagent Solution to the wells, cover with adhesive film, and incubate at 37°C for 30 min.

steps.title: Develop Color with DNPH
steps.instruction: Remove the adhesive film and add 50 μl DNPH Color Solution to the wells, then re-cover with a second film and incubate at 37°C for 10 min.

steps.title: Stop Reaction and Read Absorbance
steps.instruction: Remove the adhesive film and add 200 μl of 0.5 M NaOH to each well, then read the absorbance at 510 nm using a plate reader.

steps.title: Calculate Results
steps.instruction: Construct a standard curve by plotting the average absorbance of serially-diluted oxaloacetate standards against their concentration in U/l to calculate unknown values.
